    Lemma 4.3: the endpoint equalities #

    For a gentle algebra and a string w of positive length, and a vertex v,

    • s_v - η_v = socend_v - extout_v (lemma_4_3_socle, equation (4.1)),
    • t_v - θ_v = topend_v - extin_v (lemma_4_3_top, equation (4.2)),

    where s_v = dim Hom(S_v, M), η_v = dim Ext¹(M, S_v), t_v = dim Hom(M, S_v), θ_v = dim Ext¹(S_v, M), socend_v/topend_v count socle/top endpoints over v, and extout_v/extin_v count outgoing extending arrows ending at v / incoming extending arrows starting at v, one for each endpoint at which they extend.

    The counting inequalities of Inequality.lean are equalities (reverse injections in Step A, a five-case count in Step B), and the dimension bounds for Ext¹ are equalities over quadratic monomial data (ExtExact.lean).

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.sum_Z_ge {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hs : IsString D w) (v : D.Q.V) :
    Fintype.card { x : Fin (w.len + 1) × Bool // w.vtx x.1 = v ∧ w.InSlot x.1 x.2 } + w.extout v ≤ ∑ b : { b : D.Q.A // D.Q.tgt b = v }, Fintype.card { q : Fin (w.len + 1) // w.vtx q = D.Q.src ↑b ∧ ∀ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), D.toPathData.Forbidden a ↑b → w.next a i ≠ some q }

    Step A, reverse. Incoming slots and outgoing extensions inject into the pairs counted by Σ_b Z_b.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.sum_Y_ge {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hs : IsString D w) (v : D.Q.V) :
    Fintype.card { x : Fin (w.len + 1) × Bool // w.vtx x.1 = v ∧ w.OutSlot x.1 x.2 } + w.extin v ≤ ∑ b : { b : D.Q.A // D.Q.src b = v }, Fintype.card { q : Fin (w.len + 1) // w.vtx q = D.Q.tgt ↑b ∧ ∀ (c : D.Q.A), D.toPathData.Forbidden (↑b) c → w.next c q = none }

    Step A', reverse.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.pointwise_B_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : w.NoForks) (hn : 0 < w.len) (p : Fin (w.len + 1)) :
    ((((if w.InSlot p false then 1 else 0) + if w.InSlot p true then 1 else 0) + if ∀ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i ≠ some p then 1 else 0) + if w.IsEnd p ∧ ∃ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i = some p then 1 else 0) = (if ∀ (a : D.Q.A), w.next a p = none then 1 else 0) + 1

    The per-position count behind Step B is exact.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.pointwise_B'_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : w.NoForks) (hn : 0 < w.len) (p : Fin (w.len + 1)) :
    ((((if w.OutSlot p false then 1 else 0) + if w.OutSlot p true then 1 else 0) + if ∀ (a : D.Q.A), w.next a p = none then 1 else 0) + if w.IsEnd p ∧ ∃ (a : D.Q.A) (j : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a p = some j then 1 else 0) = (if ∀ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i ≠ some p then 1 else 0) + 1
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.step_B_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : w.NoForks) (hn : 0 < w.len) (v : D.Q.V) :
    Fintype.card { x : Fin (w.len + 1) × Bool // w.vtx x.1 = v ∧ w.InSlot x.1 x.2 } + Fintype.card { p : Fin (w.len + 1) // w.vtx p = v ∧ ∀ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i ≠ some p } + w.socend v = Fintype.card { p : Fin (w.len + 1) // w.vtx p = v ∧ ∀ (a : D.Q.A), w.next a p = none } + Fintype.card { p : Fin (w.len + 1) // w.vtx p = v }
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.step_B'_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : w.NoForks) (hn : 0 < w.len) (v : D.Q.V) :
    Fintype.card { x : Fin (w.len + 1) × Bool // w.vtx x.1 = v ∧ w.OutSlot x.1 x.2 } + Fintype.card { p : Fin (w.len + 1) // w.vtx p = v ∧ ∀ (a : D.Q.A), w.next a p = none } + w.topend v = Fintype.card { p : Fin (w.len + 1) // w.vtx p = v ∧ ∀ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i ≠ some p } + Fintype.card { p : Fin (w.len + 1) // w.vtx p = v }
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.lemma_4_3_socle {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [FiniteDimensional k B] (D : MonomialData k B) (hD : D.IsGentle) (w : Word D.Q) (hw : Word.IsString D w) (hn : 0 < w.len) (v : D.Q.V) :
    ↑(Module.finrank k (D.simple v →ₗ[B] Word.stringModule D w hw)) - ↑(Module.finrank k ↥(Ext1 k B (Word.stringModule D w hw) (D.simple v))) = ↑(w.socend v) - ↑(w.extout v)

    Lemma 4.3, equation (4.1): s - η = Σ_{socle endpoints} ε_v - Σ_{outgoing extending arrows} ε_{v'}, coordinatewise.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.lemma_4_3_top {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [FiniteDimensional k B] (D : MonomialData k B) (hD : D.IsGentle) (w : Word D.Q) (hw : Word.IsString D w) (hn : 0 < w.len) (v : D.Q.V) :
    ↑(Module.finrank k (Word.stringModule D w hw →ₗ[B] D.simple v)) - ↑(Module.finrank k ↥(Ext1 k B (D.simple v) (Word.stringModule D w hw))) = ↑(w.topend v) - ↑(w.extin v)

    Lemma 4.3, equation (4.2): t - θ = Σ_{top endpoints} ε_v - Σ_{incoming extending arrows} ε_{v'}, coordinatewise.
